svg.aria-label: Ayesha's messy desktop. A code editor with a dev server open. A bookshelf: currently reading one extremely fast-paced thriller, no spoilers. A recipe for lebu-cha: 1 cup water, 1 and a half spoons sugar or honey, 1 cardamom, a pinch of cinnamon, a handful of mint, some squeezed lime. A machine learning notebook with a loss curve. A log of nuclear accidents: Chernobyl, Fukushima, Kyshtym, Three Mile Island, Windscale, Goiania, Tokaimura. A to-do list of questionable decisions. 17 browser tabs open, 4 important, she doesn't know which 4.

g.text: kettle's on. everything else can wait.
